text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Oryaaaaaa~~h!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Despite it being a day off, Special Week
is fired up and running laps...!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I have some very, very important business today,
so I was just getting ready for it!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right! Trainer, won't you
come cheer for me too?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just what could be waiting for us...?
I decided to accompany Special Week.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
This is it!
My big moment today!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
For some reason, a long table was set up outside the diner,
and an elderly couple stood beside it...

text_block_list.name: Middle-Aged Man A
text_block_list.text:
We've been waiting for ya, Spe-chan!
We're fully prepared!

text_block_list.name: Middle-Aged Woman A
text_block_list.text: I'm counting on you today, Spe-chan.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Yes, the pleasure is all mine!
Let's get started right away!

text_block_list.name: Middle-Aged Man A
text_block_list.text:
Alrighty!
Come on, Ma, keep 'em coming!

text_block_list.name: Middle-Aged Woman A
text_block_list.text:
"You betcha!
Spe-chan, eat up, eat as much as you want~!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The elderly couple placed steaming,
heaping dishes onto the table one after another!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
—Actually, I've decided to help
promote these gentlemen's shop!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
This shop always makes so much delicious food for me,
so I really wanted to give something back...

text_block_list.name: Middle-Aged Woman A
text_block_list.text:
Spe-chan always looks like she's enjoying her food so much,
so watching her gave me the idea~

text_block_list.name: Middle-Aged Man A
text_block_list.text:
I figured if people saw me eating a ton
in front of the shop, it'd make great advertising!
choice_data_list: So that's why you were running—to work up an appetite...
So that's why you were running—to work up an appetite, huh...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I'm going to eat lots today
and let everyone know just how delicious this restaurant is!

text_block_list.name: Middle-Aged Man A
text_block_list.text:
—Gather 'round, folks! We've got a young lady
from Tracen Academy placing the order of the century!

text_block_list.name: Middle-Aged Woman A
text_block_list.text:
"They said they'd eat everything on our menu!
Everyone, cheer them on, won't ya~?"

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Waah, looks mighty tasty~!
I'm gonna eat every last bit today~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Between the elderly couple and Special Week's loud voices,
along with the mouth-watering aroma, a crowd began to gather!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer. For the sake of the old men,
I definitely want to finish every last bite!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"So... could you please
give me some advice?!"

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
—Yes!
If it's that, I'm confident I can do it!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Trainer, thank you so much for the advice!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
All right...
Time to dig iiin!!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: —*munch, nom nom nom, chomp*!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Mmm♪
It's wicked delicious, eh~~~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Special Week happily devoured
every single item on the menu.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The onlookers who were watching rushed right into the store.
The promotion ended in overwhelming success.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? W-What do you mean,
you have "nothing to say"!?
choice_data_list: Just trust yourself and eat like you normally do, you'll be fine.
Just trust yourself and eat like you normally do, you'll be fine!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: My usual self—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Understood. I'll—
eat it all up deliciously, just like always!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Trainer, thank you so much for the advice!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
All right...
Time to dig iiin!!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: —*munch, nom nom nom, chomp*!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Mmm♪
It's wicked delicious, eh~~~!

text_block_list.text:
Special Week happily devoured
every single item on the menu.

text_block_list.text:
The onlookers who were watching rushed right into the store.
The promotion ended in overwhelming success.
